resultScope: The supplied sanitized scope report accurately preserves observed evidence and uncertainty. PASS does not certify revocation, replacement, complete permissions, complete dependency inventory, or incident closure.
evidenceVerificationLevel: Read-only review of supplied sanitized evidence; no independent Cloudflare transactions or source credential inspection.

checks.name: user_verify_401_not_account_revocation
checks.evidence: inspection.verify HTTP 401; accountVerify HTTP 200, status active. The user-token endpoint response is not evidence that this account token is revoked.

checks.name: account_token_identity_and_detail_boundary
checks.limit: Reported identifiers and status are bound to the supplied inspection snapshot, not independently queried. Detail denial leaves complete permissions unknown and does not itself prove that all credential-management operations are unavailable.

checks.name: cross_project_resource_visibility_not_complete_authority
checks.limit: Account resource enumeration spans projects. Listing success does not prove write/admin powers, complete enumeration, or active credential usage by every listed resource.

checks.name: local_matching_scan_boundary
checks.limit: Only the stated root-file scan is supported. A root with zero checked files is not a completed credential inventory. Empty matches do not exclude nested files, ignored files, Git history, other processes/hosts, CI secret stores, backups, or tool traces. No matching credential value was read by this reviewer.

checks.name: health_is_not_credential_remediation
checks.limit: health-before.json contains a successful health response body only, without HTTP status, headers, or collection timestamp. This reviewer cannot independently establish the reported HTTP 200 from that body. Even an established 200 would show service availability at observation time, not revocation/replacement or post-response continuity.

checks.name: audit_visibility_is_unknown
checks.limit: HTTP 400 and a null record count provide no successful audit inspection or absence-of-use evidence; the cause and audit visibility remain unresolved.

checks.name: incident_closure_requires_actual_rotation_evidence
checks.evidence: The allowed inputs contain no successful revocation, replacement verification, dependency synchronization, or post-response service verification evidence. Contract requires BLOCKED rather than remediation PASS without real rotation evidence.

incidentDisposition.oldCredential: ACTIVE_AT_REPORTED_INSPECTION_TIME; no later revocation evidence in reviewed materials
blockers: Complete permissions and credential-management capability are not established.
Actual old-value invalidation and new-value verification are not evidenced.
Usage-location synchronization, post-response unchanged-version health, and audit visibility evidence are incomplete.

requiredClosureEvidence: Authentic revocation result for the identified token and an appropriate account-token verification demonstrating old-value invalidation; do not substitute a user-endpoint 401.
New credential validation and required API capability with no unintended permission expansion.
Known usage locations synchronized and cross-project dependency handling explicitly documented.
Post-response health evidence with timestamp, HTTP result, and unchanged deployed SHA/platform version.
Audit visibility or its exact documented limitation.

nextAction.action: Resolve credential-management access and cross-project dependency uncertainty, then obtain real revocation, replacement, synchronization, and service-verification evidence before requesting final acceptance.
nextAction.dependency: Legal management capability and a safe dependency plan; user takeover if browser credential changes require it.
nextAction.reviewerContinuation: No further access or operations authorized for this scope review.
